notes.title: Beta Testers, You Rock!
notes.notes:
[p]Huge shoutout to everyone who joined us for the Private Beta over the past few months—you’ve been absolute legends. As a thank-you, you’ve been granted a [b]full retail copy[/b] of the game, totally free. You earned it.[/p][p]
All other beta keys have now been revoked. But don’t worry—if you missed out, you can still jump into the action! Just hit [b]Request Access[/b] below to join the [b]Public Test[/b] and get a taste of what’s coming.[/p][p]
The main branch has been updated with a ton of community-driven changes. Your feedback helped shape the game in a big way, and we’re stoked to keep building with you.[/p][p]
[b]Test Phase 1 Complete – What’s Next?[/b] [/p][p]The current test phase has wrapped up, but don’t worry—[b]a new one is on the horizon[/b] and it’s shaping up to be even better.
[/p][p] We’ve simplified [b]resource gathering[/b] after spotting a few onboarding hiccups. Thanks to everyone who flagged those issues—it’s now smoother and more intuitive for new players jumping in.
[/p][p]As always, we want to hear from you! Drop your ideas, wishlist features, or wild concepts for the next chapter of [b]TitanForce[/b]. Whether it’s gameplay tweaks, lore expansions, or mech upgrades—we’re listening.[/p][p]Let’s keep building this world together. The next phase is coming… well soon ^^[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44898466/887eb431aa633b998891ce111a5551ce8ec45226.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Earth is lost
notes.notes:
Earth had fallen. The cities were overrun, by a relentless horde of zombies, the result of a catastrophic experiment gone awry. The undead were relentless, and no cure could turn back the tide of decay that swept over the planet.

The remnants of humanity turned to the only hope left: Titans. These machines were the legacy of a bygone era, their origins lost to myth and legend, now resurrected as humanity’s last line of defense.

In the heart of the wasteland that was once a thriving metropolis, the Titanforge facility stood as a bastion of hope. Here, engineers and soldiers worked side by side, forging alliances and crafting their path to survival.

Commander Maya Strickland, a veteran of countless battles, led the charge. She was a master pilot, her mind and spirit fused with her Titan, Aegis Prime. Together, they were an unstoppable force, her strategic prowess matched only by the Titan’s raw power.

As the sun set on what could be Earth’s final day, the ground shook with the approach of the undead legion. The air was filled with the electric hum of the Titans powering up, their eyes glowing like beacons in the encroaching darkness.

“Today, we fight not just for our lives, but for the future of all humanity!” Commander Strickland’s voice boomed over the comms. “We are the Titans and we will hold the line!”

The battle was a symphony of destruction. Aegis Prime’s cannons roared, cutting swathes through the undead ranks. Each Titan moved with lethal grace, their pilots’ wills bending metal and circuitry to their command.

As the night wore on, the tide began to turn. The relentless advance of the zombies was halted, then pushed back. The Titans stood tall amidst the chaos, their forms battered but unbroken.

When dawn broke, the survivors emerged from their mechs, weary but alive. They had won the battle, but the war for Earth’s future was just beginning.

In the aftermath, Commander Strickland looked out over the horizon. The world was changed, but as long as the Titans stood, there was hope. 

And so, the Titans marched on, their metal feet echoing the heartbeat of a world fighting to live once more.

notes.title: Echoes of the Sundering
notes.notes:
[b]Echoes of the Sundering[/b]

The ship’s name was [b]Stardancer,[/b] its once-gleaming hull now scarred by cosmic tempests. [b]Elara[/b], the ship’s sentient computer, watched as they emerged from the black hole’s maw, disoriented and blinking at the cryptic coordinates on the navigation screen.

The viewport revealed a snowy planet—a canvas of white punctuated by towering mountain peaks. Elara’s circuits hummed with curiosity. Where were they? How had the black hole flung them here?

X02, the lone hero, stepped onto the frozen ground. The cold bit through their suit, but determination fueled their steps. The Stardancer loomed behind them, damaged but defiant.

The peaks whispered secrets—the Architects’ secrets. They had crafted the black hole, seeking answers beyond the veil of reality. But their hubris had torn existence apart. Now, in this snowy expanse, X02’s mission unfolded: to mend what was broken.

The ruins beckoned—a fractured city half-buried in snow. Elara guided X02 toward the remnants of a civilization torn asunder. Glyphs adorned the walls—symbols of power long dormant. X02 traced them, feeling the pulse of forgotten magic. Perhaps here lay the answer—the Key of Nexus, said to bridge worlds.

In a hidden chamber, the holographic pedestal flickered. X02 inserted the Key, and the room trembled. Images swirled—a cosmic ballet of creation and destruction.

And then, as if guided by cosmic hands, a shimmering portal materialized—a rift in space itself. It hung before X02, its edges dancing with otherworldly light. Elara’s voice crackled through the earpiece:

“X02, step through. This is your path—the desert planet awaits.”

X02 hesitated, their gaze lingering on the fractured city, the ruins of a civilization lost to time. But destiny beckoned. With a deep breath, they stepped into the portal, leaving behind the Stardancer and the echoes of the Sundering.

The teleporter hummed, as X02 stepped forward, their silhouette merging with the desert’s horizon. Elara watched, her circuits alight with hope. The Sundering had fractured reality, but perhaps, just perhaps, X02 held the key to stitching it back—one shard, one story at a time.

The desert planet embraced them—a world reborn, its snowy peaks now replaced by sun-scorched dunes.

And so, X02 stood on the sun-baked sands, ready to unravel the mysteries that awaited—the Architects’ legacy, Zee’s forgotten saga, and the cosmic harmony yearning to be restored.

notes.title: The Situation.
notes.notes:
In the aftermath of the [b]Sundering[/b], X02, a Mech of unparalleled resilience, finds itself stranded on a desert planet. This world, alive with the latent energy of the cosmos, presents a formidable challenge to X02’s every function and tests its resolve.

As X02’s sensors activate, the vastness of the dunes unfolds before it, an endless canvas of secrets and history buried beneath the sands. With each determined step, X02 embarks on a quest to uncover the arcane mysteries that pulse beneath the surface, seeking the salvation that lies hidden within the planet’s core.

The desert’s silence is X02’s sole companion as it listens for the faint whispers of ancient technology. Scavenging and adapting, X02 uses the remnants of a civilization long gone to repair its battered frame and rekindle the embers of its once-mighty power.

But X02 is not alone in this barren land. Beneath the twin moons, shadows stir, and remnants of a time before pose threats to its mission. Yet, with each encounter, X02 grows stronger, its legend as the guardian of this forsaken world solidifying with every victory.

Amidst the ruins, the past calls out to X02. The saga of Zee and the Eon-Scarred Architects is a puzzle scattered across the sands, waiting for X02 to piece it together, to remember the glory that once was and could be again.

In this journey of rediscovery and warfare, X02 is not a solitary wanderer. The strength of allies becomes its strength, their resolve its shield. Together, they forge a path through the trials set by the planet, rising not just as survivors, but as champions of a new era.

This is the saga of X02, a tale of survival, discovery, and unity. A tale that will be told across the stars for eons to come.
